outcome: Combined outcome (death or any severe morbidity)
cohort: The study included 4337 very preterm infants (VPIs) born to diabetic mothers, recruited from 79 NICUs within the Chinese Neonatal Network.
finding: Antenatal corticosteroid exposure in very preterm infants of diabetic mothers was associated with lower mortality and reduced risks of severe BPD, low Apgar score, RDS, and invasive ventilation, but also with higher odds of maternal chorioamnionitis.
